text: Closing your ZX Bank Credit Card is a straightforward process. Follow the steps below to ensure a smooth and secure closure:
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card

locations.heading: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card

text:
- Pay Off All Dues: Settle any outstanding amounts (balances, fees, charges, or EMI on the card).
- Download Statements: Keep a record of your final statement for future reference.
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > 1. Clear Outstanding Dues

text: - Check for Points: Redeem all reward points, cashback, or benefits, as they will be lost after closure.
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > 2. Redeem Unused Rewards

text: - Deactivate: Cancel standing instructions, auto-debits, or subscriptions linked to your card.
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > 3. Cancel Auto-debits & Linked Payments

text: You can place a closure request using any of the following channels:
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > 4. Request Card Closure

text:
1. Login to the app.
2. Go to Card Services > Credit Card Closure.
3. Select your card and follow the on-screen prompts.
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > 4. Request Card Closure > a. Via ZX Bank Mobile App ("ZX Bank Asia")

locations.heading: a. Via ZX Bank Mobile App ("ZX Bank Asia")

text:
1. Login to ZX NetBanking.
2. Navigate to Cards > Credit Cards > Close Credit Card.
3. Select your credit card and confirm your request.
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > 4. Request Card Closure > b. Through ZX NetBanking

text:
- Call 24x7 helpline:
  - India: 1800-123-4567
  - Sri Lanka: 011-2345678
  - Bangladesh: 0961-234567
- Request card closure with your card details handy.
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > 4. Request Card Closure > c. Customer Care

text:
- Visit your nearest ZX Bank branch.
- Submit a written request or fill out a card closure form.
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > 4. Request Card Closure > d. Branch Visit

text: - After confirmation, cut your card (including chip and magnetic strip) and dispose of it securely.
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > 5. Destroy the Card

text:
- Closure Letter/Email: ZX Bank will send a closure confirmation within 7 working days.
- Check CIBIL/Credit Report: Ensure the card appears as ‘closed’ (not ‘settled’).
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > 6. Obtain Closure Confirmation

text:
- Closing a credit card may affect your credit score.
- You cannot re-activate a closed card; a new application is required.
- If you see continuing charges post-closure, inform ZX Bank immediately.
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > #### Important Notes

text: For help, contact ZX Bank Customer Care via the ZX Bank Asia mobile app or visit www.zxbank.asia (http://www.zxbank.asia).
path: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card > #### Important Notes
